correctness.rationale: Open edge-neighborhoods of the K2 spine and 2n spokes reduce exactly to singleton multiplicities in the nine ordered spoke-pair types (a,b). For a spoke, side color totals differ by at most one deletion plus the opposite spoke and spine, so clipping each type at 3 leaves equality-to-one predicates invariant. Independent complete enumeration of all 4^9=262144 capped vectors found precisely 18 feasible states with any 3, and none with all entries <=2 and total >=5. For n>=5 these yield six one-exception and twelve two-exception families, giving 3(6n+12n(n−1))=18n(2n−1) named colorings; direct graph enumeration independently found 198,1080,810 for n=3,4,5. The two-color spine singleton argument rules out palettes smaller than 3 for all n>=3. Source theorem, named palette convention and page-index multiplicities match.
